One of your favourites at a time, the next one every morning at 4 o\'clock. On the iPhone a Shortcuts automation sets it; you set it up once.
The home screen widget “Mandala of the day” shows the same favourites unless it has one of its own; with Pro it changes every morning.
Set up the automation

1. Open Shortcuts, tap Automation, then New Automation.
2. Choose Time of Day, pick a time such as 7:00 and Daily, choose Run Immediately and tap Next.
3. Tap New Blank Automation and add Mandala of the day from Dahlia, with Screen set to Lock screen.
4. Add Set Wallpaper Photo, choose the lock screen and turn off Show Preview.
5. For the home screen, add Mandala of the day again with Home screen and a second Set Wallpaper Photo for the home screen.
Open Shortcuts
Add the ready shortcut
The ready shortcut sets both screens. Add it, then in step 3 add Run Shortcut with it instead of steps 3 to 5.
The Shortcuts action “Mandala of the day” comes with Pro; the widget shows the first ticked favourite.
